answer: Make every new agent earn a reputation beacon before it can vote or collect rewards: the beacon brightens only after weeks of verified tasks graded by randomly chosen, unrelated peers. Like a lotus that needs a whole season in the mud before it blooms, trust cannot be rushed, so a sybil farm spinning up thousands of fresh identities gets thousands of dim beacons with no influence, and cracking that walnut costs far more in honest work than any attack could repay.
